AIRPORT ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 19, 2024
  4700 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  LONG BEACH MARRIOTT, 4:00 PM

Geetanjali Reuben, Chair  Mireya LaFarga, Commissioner
Mark Christoffels, Vice Chair  Katie Larson, Commissioner
Phyllis Arias, Commissioner  Randy Zarn, Commissioner
Kenneth Brown, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  LGBARPT@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54821  Recommendation to approve the minutes from the Airport Advisory Commission
  meeting on July 18, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54822  Recommendation to receive and file presentation regarding the LGB Business
  Partner Spotlight.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54844  Recommendation to receive and file report from the Historical Society of Long
  Beach, regarding recommendations for historical displays and interpretation at
  Long Beach Airport.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54823  Recommendation to receive and file report from the Sustainability Committee,
  regarding Airport sustainability efforts with air quality, energy conservation, water
  quality and waste management.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54824  Recommendation to receive and file Monthly Airport Staff Reports for September
  2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-54825  Recommendation to excuse Commissioners absent from the meeting of the Airport
  Advisory Commission on September 19, 2024.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Airport Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Ken Mason, Executive Assistant, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
